delivery_role_note: Interactive selectors, maps, and decision trees may help voters find the right official next step, but they remain subordinate to the current official page, notice, directory, or office that controls the answer.
question_scope_note: Helps route voters to the current official page or office for registration, ballot request, voting location, and basic accommodation paths. Does not decide record-specific eligibility disputes.
conflict_stop_behavior: If current official source anchors materially conflict or the router does not safely cover the case, stop and hand the user to the current official office/help path instead of synthesizing a rule.
privacy_minimization_note: Collect only the inputs necessary to route the voter and avoid storing raw addresses or session details longer than the published policy requires.
